description: Use this to list recent indexed XDaLa sessions from the read-only Explorer database, especially when the user does not know owner and sessionId. Supports optional owner filtering, time windows, result limits and payload enrichment.

includePayload.description: Value for the include payload parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

windowHours.description: Value for the window hours parameter.

name: get_recent_xdala_sessions

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Get recent XDaLa sessions
